headword: {人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}
gloss: kanji approved for use in personal names

definitions.explanation: A government-designated list of about 860 kanji that may be used in a child's given name in addition to the general-use {常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}. Characters outside both lists cannot be registered at the city office.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: This character is on the list of kanji approved for names.

examples.japanese: {人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{追加|ついか}される→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧。
examples.english: Kanji approved for personal names are added from time to time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}でなければ、{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Unless a character is a general-use kanji or an approved name kanji, it cannot be used in a child's name.

notes:
Defined by ministerial ordinance and revised occasionally, usually when parents petition for a character. The list exists to keep names readable and registrable, so it includes many older or decorative characters that are not part of everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追加|ついか}される→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧: to be added to the name-kanji list
- {人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: the table of approved name kanji
- {人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧: characters outside the approved list

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧: general-use kanji — the 2,136 characters for ordinary writing; names may also use these
- ⟦{表外漢字|ひょうがいかんじ}→表外漢字：30393_hyougaikanji⟧: kanji outside the lists — cannot be used in a newly registered name
